executionScope.scope: Retained initial public rows, pure source geometric measurements and the pinned policy admission predicate only.

transcribedPredicates: EnvelopeFillAccess.propose: same-extent contrast geometry only; no acquired context assumed

no_visible_effect_contract.meaning: An exact point command with no visible pixel change and no official progress closes only this measured probe. Selection and impossibility remain unacquired; an invisible control remains unknown. Retain epoch, observation evidence, full frame, motif, point and payload. Reject the same offer while these premises remain unchanged. Re-examine other declared composition families; no unscoped input fallback is licensed by this return. A click-to-motion experiment needs its own explicit hypothesis, current binding and falsifier.

nested_control_question.question: Test the unique smallest measured compact solid core within a measured closed two-value square enclosure. Its control role is hypothetical. Bind one exact point, preserve local and distant changes as separate observations, and close at the first unknown effect before inferring a resource, quantity, relay or terminal role.

envelope_fill_question.question: Measure current pixel-band extents inside retained public supports. One repeat discriminates accumulation from a one-off effect; an independently framed control with different glyph tests another transformation. Opposed measured changes do not establish a universal inverse. Preserve unknown quantities, capacity, ordering, relay and release laws; seal each first unknown response and retain all evidence.

field_service_question.question: After measured restoration, test isolation of a correlated field that did not produce the distinct replacement. Prefer the other observed replacement as an exploration target, not a terminal role. A paired mirror motif on its measured axis is only a control hypothesis. Reconcile its local response, then test the previously observed input under changed conditions; all quantities, capacities and passage laws remain unknown.

field_service_transfer.question: Rebind the measured relay and receiver shapes from the successful public epoch to current occurrences. Revalidate the retained control orientation and conditional input through current returns. A receiver without its initial background is only a fullness hypothesis; protection is revisable. If receivers match but the intermediate does not, prepare each receiver control under its current measured envelope before testing the known input against the unknown dependency. Reconcile every new field response; do not infer capacity, release threshold, duration or terminal completion from appearance.

selection.criterion: Unique retained initial view combining a unique smallest compact enclosure, paired reflected motifs, and exactly one same-extent distinct enclosure.
selection.nextTarget: Transfer the generic acquired field/service chain, then evaluate one cold continuous campaign targeting the first three levels.
requiredAcquisitions: persistent public fields and repeatable pixel extent changes
actual prior-state restoration by a distinct current control
novel replacement and spatial control association after restoration
actual isolation and service responses before model retention
official boundary witness and current geometric rebinding for cross-epoch reuse
